name: Áine Grym
source:
[url=/c146899]Cymhen[/url]'s firstborn. Áine is a talented healer and physician, and works as Cymhen's right-hand when not on rotation in the hospital owned by the Grym family. A welcoming presence, it was always a pleasure to spend time with her during my visits to the Grym manor.
